items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern digital rendering of a historical script form, not a dated artifact image
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of 要 in a Shuowen seal-script style. The Han dictionary describes 要 as the body's middle and offers a hands-at-the-waist interpretation; early graph analyses remain disputed.
items.alt: Black vector outline of 要 in seal-script style, presented as a modern redraw.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description page identifies the graph and script style, supplies the original SVG link, names the source image, and states public-domain reuse. It provides a usable late historical form for comparison with disputed early analyses.
items.rights: Commons page states that the SVG representation is public domain; the file page also records that its digital source was Richard Sears, with courtesy permission. Modern vector redraw.

limitations.text: This image is a modern vector rendering of a seal-script form, not an ancient inscription photograph; it cannot independently resolve the competing analyses of the Shang graph.
No selected Shang oracle-bone or bronze inscription image was verified through an exact description page and direct file link in this research.
